413-1981-6719.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
413-1981-6719.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and by sacrificing any other creature you control, dealing 1 damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Blasting Station and Dazzling Angel trigger.
Resolve the Dazzling Angel trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.

413-522--5.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Melira.
When the creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.

1981-2415-3188-5686.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-3188-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to the creature with changeling

2921-4640-7082--201.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature with changeling.
When that creature dies, Oathkeeper triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When that creature enters, Sokka and Suki triggers, allowing you to attach Oathkeeper to that creature.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

907-1558-3875-4231-7810.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
907-1558-3875-4231-7810.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Tippy-Toe.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

341-489-2781-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Felidar Guardian from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

63-1651-4013-7685.description:
Activate Arc Reactor by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Wernog.
When Wernog leaves and enters, it triggers twice, creating at least two Clue tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Clues, untapping Arc Reactor.
Repeat.
63-1651-4013-7685.notes: Because your opponents must choose to either let themselves and you investigate, or lose life, this combo will very likely result in infinite Clue tokens for you and your opponents.

240-3480-4050-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing an Egg token, adding one mana of any color
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

628-6798-7217.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Moonshadow.
When Moonshadow dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat.

851-4017-4050-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
851-4017-4050-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color
Repeat from step 1.

275-2034-4871-6632-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Transplant Theorist by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to The Water Crystal.
Repeat.

413-3817-4200.description:
Cast Icewind Stalwart by paying its mana cost.
When Icewind Stalwart enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Stastion trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Icewind Stalwart.
Resolve the Icewind Stalwart ability, blinking Sister Hospitaller
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Sister Hospitaller trigger, returning Icewind Stalwart from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-1358-3000-3899-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Sydri.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

4067-6100-6281-7013.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures that share a creature type.
4067-6100-6281-7013.description:
Activate White Lotus Tile by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Elvish Regrower.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Elvish Regrower that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Elvish Regrower token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Elvish Regrower from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping White Lotus Tile.
Repeat.

1173-3976-6853.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1173-3976-6853.description:
Cast Final Fortune by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and to lose the game at the beginning of that turn's end step.
Activate Magar by paying {1}{B}{R}, noting Final Fortune and putting it face down on the battlefield as a 3/3 creature.
Activate Magar by paying {1}{B}{R}, noting Day's Undoing and putting it face down on the battlefield as a 3/3 creature.
During your next turn, deal combat damage to an opponent using the face down creatures that have Final Fortune and Day's Undoing noted. The creatures trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, casting a copy of Final Fortune without paying its mana cost. Resolve the copy, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and to lose the game at the beginning of that turn's end step.
Resolve the second trigger, casting a copy of Day's Undoing without paying its mana cost. Resolve the copy, causing you to end the turn. This will prevent the Final Fortune trigger from causing you to lose the game.
Repeat from step 3.

2457-3000-3480-4289.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

2034-3277-4871-6476.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents that each have a creature card that will enter the battlefield with greater than 0 toughness in their graveyard.
2034-3277-4871-6476.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}, returning Izzet Chronarch and at least two other creatures from graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
When Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Afterlife from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar four times by sacrificing three of the creatures returned in step 1, adding six {C}.
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating three Treasure tokens.
Activate the three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

4770-5554-6441.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Treasure or Gold token.
4770-5554-6441.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {1}{W}.
Oltec Matterweaver triggers, creating two token copies of any Treasure or Gold token you control.
When Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, or two Golds by sacrificing them, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat.

2034-3951-5703-5744.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
2034-3951-5703-5744.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat during each combat phase.

1812-1912-4222-5516.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
Red Death does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Red Death.
1812-1912-4222-5516.description:
Activate Red Death by tapping it, adding {R}, goading a creature an opponent controls and causing that opponent to draw a card.
Activate Prismite by paying {1}, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Red Death.
Repeat.

4053-4359-5499--6.notablePrerequisites: The creature with undying does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
4053-4359-5499--6.description:
Activate the creature with undying by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
When the creature dies, Solemnity triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to the undying creature.
Repeat.

261-618-3957-4613.notablePrerequisites: Famished Paladin has at least one +1/+1 counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
261-618-3957-4613.description:
Activate Famished Paladin using Kiki-Jiki's ability by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself with haste.
When the Famished Paladin token enters the battlefield, Suture Priest's first ability triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Each Famished Paladin you control triggers, untapping themselves.
Repeat.
You may also target any nonlegendary creature you control.

705-1920-4186.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a green creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
705-1920-4186.description:
Cause a green creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Sylvan Anthem triggers, causing you to scry 1.
Arwen Undómiel triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

75-3555-4050.notablePrerequisites: Rendclaw Trow does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
75-3555-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Rendclaw Trow, adding {B/G}.
When Rendclaw Trow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Activate Quillspike by paying {B/G} and removing the -1/-1 counter from Rendclaw Trow, giving Quillspike +3/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat.

608-1636-2053.notablePrerequisites: Cephalid Looter does not have summoning sickness.
608-1636-2053.description:
Activate Cephalid Looter by tapping it, causing an opponent to loot.
Xyris' first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Snake creature token.
The Snake enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

186-4131-4832.notablePrerequisites:
Ensoul Artifact attached to Basalt Monolith.
Basalt Monolith does not have summoning sickness.
186-4131-4832.description:
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

757-3181-4235.notablePrerequisites: Blossom Dryad does not have summoning sickness.
757-3181-4235.description:
Activate Magosi's second activated ability by tapping it and paying {U}.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers; choose not to pay for it.
Resolve the Magosi ability, putting an eon counter on Magosi and skipping your next turn.
Activate Blossom Dryad by tapping it targeting Magosi.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers; choose not to pay for it.
Activate Magosi's third activated ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it, and returning it to your hand.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers; pay {2} and copy the Magosi ability.
Resolve both copies of the ability, cancelling out your skipped turn and taking an extra turn after this one.
Play Magosi.
Repeat each turn.

109-868-3044-4036.description:
Cast Desperate Ritual for {1}{R}, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Cast Seething Song for {2}{R}, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Cast Ill-Gotten Gains for {2}{B}{B} and hold priority.
Cast Fork for {R}{R}, copying Ill-Gotten Gains.
Resolve the copied Ill-Gotten Gains, discarding your hand and then returning Desperate Ritual, Seething Song, and Fork to your hand.
Cast Desperate Ritual for {1}{R}, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Cast Seething Song for {2}{R}, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 4.
